description: This file implements functions related to OpenCDM session decryption and GStreamer integration, including session decryption functions, buffer handling, and caps transformation, with logging and external dependencies.

methods.name: opencdm_gstreamer_session_decrypt_ex
methods.description: Performs decryption on a session with protection metadata, handling null session case.

methods.name: opencdm_gstreamer_session_decrypt
methods.description: Wrapper around the extended decrypt function, providing default null caps parameter.

methods.name: opencdm_gstreamer_session_decrypt_buffer
methods.description: Decrypts a buffer using a session, adding protection metadata if possible, conditionally compiled.

methods.name: opencdm_gstreamer_transform_caps
methods.description: Transforms GStreamer caps, currently a no-op returning success.
